The boundary min/max showed (30,31) — because the boundary is the outer perimeter corners of the combined O+b object? No wait, pos() only looks at the O node (10 px, 2 rows). To go back to the box:
- DOWN x3 → rows 45-49, cols 19-23 (45-46, 40-41, 35-36 → O at 45-46 means the strip is at rows 45-49).
- RIGHT x3 → cols 24-28, 29-33, 34-38 (rows 45-49).
- UP x6 → strip rows 45-49 → 40-44 → 35-39 → 30-34 → 25-29 → 20-24 → 15-19.
